headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: U.S. measles cases reach 35-year high in 2026, surpassing last year’s total
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported Friday that the United States has logged 2,318 measles cases in the first seven months of this year, surpassing last year’s total of 2,289.

headlines.title: Expert Tips for Maintaining an Anti-Inflammatory Diet
headlines.description: Maintaining a healthy diet can be overwhelming, so registered dietician Keri Glassman joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to break down the best anti-inflammatory and fermented foods. Glassman recommends drinking kombucha, eating berries and vegetables, integrating extra virgin olive oil, and also shares harmful foods to avoid.

headlines.title: Fuel Up for Your Next Workout With These Nutrition Tips
headlines.description: Fueling up properly for a workout can make a big difference on energy, endurance and recovery so TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer stops by Studio 1A with tips on what foods to eat, the effectiveness of electrolytes and caffeine and more.

headlines.title: How the cyclospora outbreak is impacting the food industry
headlines.description: A rise in cases of cyclosporiasis is causing people to steer clear of lettuce, while forcing salad restaurants and major fast-food chains to set the record straight.

headlines.title: FDA panel recommends controversial treatments
headlines.description: A controversial new FDA panel recommendation could affect the sale of peptides—popular treatments marketed for benefits ranging from muscle growth to weight loss. NBC News’ Anne Thompson explains why not everyone thinks they’re a good idea.

headlines.title: The best self-tanners for dark skin in 2026

headlines.title: The 33 best dorm essentials to make the school year go smoothly — at least as your room is concerned

headlines.title: What is deodorant concealer and is the viral product safe? Derms weigh in
headlines.description: Deodorant concealer can temporarily hide dark underarms, but dermatologists warn that it may irritate skin or mask deeper issues. Here’s what to know before you try it.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak expands to 9 states
headlines.description: The massive, multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis has expanded to nine states, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said Friday.

headlines.title: FDA panel recommends easing restrictions on several peptides
headlines.description: The panel went against the conclusions of the agency’s career scientists, who said there wasn’t enough evidence to support the move.
